mentions.name: MiniHomelabs HWDB
mentions.description: A hardware database that works like a PCPartPicker for used OEM computers, letting home lab enthusiasts compare specs of old PCs. Currently focused on specs, with plans to add viable upgrade paths and explanations of the different model lineups.
mentions.problem: Comparing old PCs for home labbing is harder than it should be; built to scratch the author's own itch.
mentions.audience: It's harder than it should be to compare old pcs for home labbing
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://minihomelabs.com/hwdb - Basically the PCPartPicker of used OEM hardware.

It's harder than it should be to compare old pcs for home labbing so I've been building this to scratch my own itch. Right now it's more focused on specs but I'm working on expanding out to to include things like viable upgrades and explaining the different model lineups.
mentions.author: burnt_toast
